title: Animals Around Us
subject: Environmental Studies
objective: Students identify common animals and describe where they live using Hindi and Santali support.
steps: Show the picture cards and ask students to name animals in their mother tongue.
Read each Hindi word aloud, then show the Santali support word.
Ask students to match animals with home: water, tree, field, house.
Use the translator for teacher questions and repeat answers as a class.
teacherPrompt: आज हम अपने आसपास दिखने वाले जानवरों के बारे में सीखेंगे।
